items.text: 6In order to identify the writer of an anonymous letter, a sample of ink from the letter was dissolved in a solvent and then placed on some chromatography paper. Spots of ink from the pens of five possible writers, G, M, P, R and T, were placed next to the sample on the chromatography paper. The final chromatogram looked like this:

items.label: list_item
items.text: a Which of the five writers is using ink that matches the sample from the letter?

items.label: list_item
items.text: b Which of the writers is using a pen that contains ink made from a single dye?

items.label: list_item
items.text: c What is the R value of the blue dye in suspect P's pen?

items.label: list_item
items.text: d Which two of the five writers are using pens containing the same ink?

items.label: list_item
items.text: e Whose pen contained the dye that was most soluble in the solvent?
